notes.title: Punchout: Music Version 0.2.3.008 Update
notes.notes:
Hello.
Today, we've added the K.O. Mode to the game.

K.O. Mode
In this mode, you fail the level when you miss three notes continuously.
So, you can play the game more excited!

About new levels
New levels will added soon. Look forward to it!

Changelog
Version 0.2.3.008

 Added: K.O. Mode
 Added: Glove trails
 Added: Background Text Events (Not used yet)
 Tweaks: Music in the main menu was changed
 Tweaks: Rush notes are now cracked by your punch
 Fixed: Fixed some small bugs

notes.title: Punchout: Music Version 0.1.3.006 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
Today we've updated Punchout: Music.
In this update, we supported Oculus Rift and added Japanese translation.
We'll add new levels and difficulties in another updates.
Thanks.

Changelog
Version 0.1.3.006

 Added: Oculus Rift support
 Added: language option
 Added: Japanese translation
 Tweaks: Song loader now using UnityWebRequest instead of WWW
 Tweaks: Main menu now displays game version
 Fixed: Some small bugs
